ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobes and 25% low-intensity black pixels along the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white regions occupy the primary surface area of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a thick border along the trailing edge and leading edge margins. A vertical low-intensity black column bisects the fluke from the peduncle base to the median notch. Small, dark, non-contiguous pixel clusters (mottling) are present within the white regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated topography with high-frequency pixel-amplitude variations. Prominent larger indentations (peaks and valleys) are concentrated on the distal regions of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly concave sweep from the distal tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several localized low-intensity circular pixel clusters: one prominent cluster on the mid-lateral region of the left lobe and one on the lower-medial region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The trailing edge displays significant irregular jaggedness and potential micro-amputations across the entire span.
other_distinctive_markers: The central vertical black band exhibits a highly irregular, 'stair-step' pixelated boundary where it meets the white inner lobe regions.
